body:
Canonical source ingestion is now implemented in PR #839, version 2.0.37 / package schema 27 / catalog 35. It adds the source-qualified native_* relations to the existing EvidenceStore; no separate Presto curator or training labels are introduced.

Independent real-source replay verifies all 255,635 raw/LFQ/form/feature quantities, 73,113 complete reference records, 38,641 origin alternatives, 292,449 literal workbook cells and 228,749 source-parent alternatives. All 16 primary keys and 28 declared relationships close. Additional feature/form/publisher parent claims leave the same 1,689 dependency components as the earlier source audit. The article's triplicate/independent-experiment descriptions are now explicit figure-scoped claims; per-run specimen assignment and control/KD pairing remain unresolved.

Format/lint and 3,533 local default tests pass, including nine new fidelity fixtures. Hosted units pass on Python 3.10–3.14; integration and the tested release remain pending. The full source replay, preserved verifier failures and reproduction bundle are published here: https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/a23bc160a8c31408b82cab663ea968093a624f36/experiments/2026-10-25_0519_codex_native-source-canonical/README.md

This issue remains open. Next is an explicit canonical same-parent contrast recipe and the separately registered biological fit. Source signals are not calibrated molar concentrations, zeros are not negative labels, HEK293T is not APC validation, and this source-admission result does not demonstrate predictive gain.
